story.titleZh: 法拉利内斗葬送墨西哥站胜利？勒克莱尔与汉密尔顿首圈争夺引争议
story.summaryZh: 法拉利在墨西哥大奖赛首圈本可凭借1-2领跑控制比赛，但勒克莱尔与汉密尔顿的激烈争夺让维斯塔潘的红牛车队夺走胜利。The Race的评论认为，法拉利再次为允许车手自由竞争付出代价。
story.originalTitle: A Ferrari 1-2 thrown away? Our verdict on latest Leclerc-Hamilton spat
story.summaryEn: Ferrari could have controlled the Mexican Grand Prix from a 1-2 lead on the opening lap, but Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton's fierce battle handed victory to Max Verstappen's Red Bull. The Race's verdict argues Ferrari has once again paid the price for allowing its drivers to race each other.
detailZh: 法拉利F1车队是否因查尔斯·勒克莱尔在首圈对队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿的进攻而葬送了墨西哥大奖赛的胜利？
以下是我们对墨西哥城所发生事件的看法。
法拉利似乎忽略了蒙扎那面巨大的红旗：如果你让车手在首圈就激烈对抗，这将会让你付出代价。
法拉利在墨西哥1号弯前处于1-2领先，本可以在那之后控制比赛。
相反，勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿像在争夺年度冠军的最后一轮那样互相缠斗，把胜利拱手让给了马克斯·维斯塔潘的红牛车队。
两人在4号弯都做得太过火了——如果汉密尔顿没有冲出赛道，他就不会输给维斯塔潘。而勒克莱尔根本没能接近弯心。
法拉利不能再让他们这样互相竞争了，因为他们已经反复证明，这样做不可能不把位置送给对手。
我看不出法拉利怎么能信任自己的车手。他们在赛季后半段已经出现了三次重大冲突点——而这次是最严重的一次，因为它让法拉利丢掉了比赛胜利。这无疑为维斯塔潘打开了大门。
首先是在赞德沃特，当时气氛就有些微妙紧张，勒克莱尔拒绝了车队让他为采用不同策略的汉密尔顿让路的指令。那很自私，也没有必要。
接着是在蒙扎，首圈就发生了冲突——两人都过于拼命地互相缠斗，勒克莱尔最终把过于乐观的汉密尔顿挤出了第一个减速弯后的砂石区。在法拉利的主场比赛中，这既愚蠢又毫无必要。
现在又来了这个。两人在一定程度上都有错，勒克莱尔不必要地跟队友拼得太凶——汉密尔顿差点冲出赛道，但勒克莱尔以那个速度，试一百万次也过不了那个弯。
在F1中，法拉利的胜利很稀少，这个赛季很艰难——而且相比汉密尔顿，勒克莱尔的赛季尤其充满挑战。所以我理解他为什么在拼。他绝对应该去拼。但必须比这更有常识。
不幸的是，这现在已经成了一个明显的模式。他们（尤其是勒克莱尔）一再把自己置于车队之前，损害了法拉利的成绩，破坏了车手之间的默契，侵蚀了信任，并给一支比任何其他车队都更受放大镜审视的车队带来了不必要的关注和争议。
从微观层面看，这是自我毁灭性的，因为很难想象如果没有第4弯的那次自毁行为，法拉利会赢不下这场比赛；但从宏观层面看，考虑到更大的图景，存在一个更根本的问题。
他们正面临严重、甚至可能是致命地削弱弗雷德·瓦塞尔领导力的风险。勒克莱尔信任这个项目，正是因为他。是他把汉密尔顿带进了车队。
如果他们不愿为他守规矩，那他们还能为法拉利守规矩吗？
你本以为法拉利会从蒙扎站吸取教训——在那里勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿实际上在第一个减速弯就毁掉了他们的比赛。
这一次他们撑到了4号弯，两人双双刹车过晚，为马克斯·维斯塔潘敞开了大门，后者抓住机会取得了一场精彩的胜利。
保持公平、给两位车手同等的争胜机会是正确的做法，但如果这同时意味着冒着丢掉胜利的风险，那这种立场就站不住脚了。
在两个月前的蒙扎站已经暴露出需要及早掐灭的潜在紧张局势的情况下，如今还发生这种事，是不可原谅的。
勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿在4号弯都不愿让步，这种绝望似乎源于彼此缺乏信任，或许还有车队管理层不愿介入的因素，而这是必须解决的问题，因为总有一天法拉利丢掉的将不只是分站胜利——这种事足以让你丢掉总冠军。
在我看来，法拉利这次失利归根结底是汉密尔顿的错。尽管我们永远无法知道，如果他在起步时守住领先位置，能否挡住后来猛烈追击的维斯塔潘。
如果汉密尔顿在第一圈与勒克莱尔的缠斗中没有跑宽，他本会处于领先并掌控比赛。好吧，也许勒克莱尔本该被告知不要拼得那么凶，但在法拉利没有任何比赛规则的情况下，汉密尔顿只能像对待其他车手一样与勒克莱尔竞争。
即便有规则存在，你也得准备好队友会违反规则。F1的历史告诉我们这一点！
如果汉密尔顿没有犯那个错误，在那次交锋之后他本应处于领先。
我非常尊重汉密尔顿，但他在比赛中花了太多时间在无线电上摆姿态，而实际上他应该为自己在这次事件中的角色承担责任。
法拉利不能像毫无损失那样去比赛
由于夺冠希望早已破灭，你可能会说法拉利现在已经没有什么可失去的了，所以它的车手们应该在剩余比赛中各自放手一搏。
但考虑到这支车队已经很久没有赢得任何冠军，考虑到法拉利每次做出任何令人失望的事情（自2000年代中期以来大多数时候都是如此）时都会承受巨大压力，它现在需要团结、纪律以及流畅、和谐的比赛中执行。
它本场比赛中完全有机会以1-2完赛。它需要一个计划来确保第一圈结束时处于实现这一目标的位置，并且需要知道它可以信任车手们执行该计划。这些它都没有。
当你没有明确界定的一号车手，而你的两位车手在速度上又相当接近时，你总是容易陷入这些情况。
我们已经在塞纳和普罗斯特、曼塞尔和皮奎特、汉密尔顿和罗斯伯格、诺里斯和皮亚斯特里之间看到过这种情况，甚至在红牛意识到没有这种明确界定你会失去更多而不是获得更多之前，维斯塔潘和里卡多之间也是如此。
我们已经多次看到法拉利相当慢，而且还要加上他们在维修区策略决策上的薄弱。这场比赛的问题在于勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿都在出4号弯时冲出赛道，然而汉密尔顿确实在赛道上压到了5号弯的弯心，而勒克莱尔根本不在意，并且明显拉开了优势，所以对此处以五秒罚时是合理的。
然而这并不能弥补汉密尔顿在比赛第一阶段不得不行驶在脏空气中而遭受的时间损失，而勒克莱尔却能在干净空气中跑在前面。
我不知道除了在赛道上立即执行罚时之外你还能怎么做，所以基本上在这种情况下，如果车手本人或车队在国际汽联做出决定时没有要求其车手让出获得的位置或获得的时间，那么你必须在下次越过起终点线前让出所施加罚时的时间损失。
如果这意味着你失去更多位置，那就这样吧。
更令人有些担忧的是，勒克莱尔似乎没有从最初那次事件中吸取任何教训，在红旗后的重新起步时，他的驾驶风格同样激进，甚至更加激进。
马拉内罗——或者他们周一进行赛后复盘的任何地方——将会有点热闹。
detailEn: Did the Ferrari Formula 1 team cost itself Mexican Grand Prix victory with Charles Leclerc’s first lap attack on team-mate Lewis Hamilton?
Here’s our take on what unfolded at Mexico City.
Ferrari appears to have missed the giant red flag of Monza: if you let your drivers race each other hard on lap one, it’s going to cost you.
Ferrari was 1-2 on the approach to Turn 1 in Mexico and it could have controlled the race thereafter.
Instead Leclerc and Hamilton battled each other like it was a final round title decider and handed victory to Max Verstappen’s Red Bull.
Both went too far in Turn 4 - if Hamilton hadn’t gone off the track he wouldn’t have lost out to Verstappen. And Leclerc wasn’t anywhere near making the corner.
Ferrari can’t keep letting them race like this because they’ve now repeatedly proved they can’t do it without gifting places to rivals.

I don't see how Ferrari can trust its drivers. They've had three significant flashpoints in the second half of the season - with this being the most severe of all, given it has cost Ferrari a race victory. It certainly opened the door to Verstappen.
First there was low-key tension at Zandvoort, when Leclerc rejected a team instruction to move aside for Hamilton on a different strategy. That was selfish and unnecessary.

Then came the clash on the opening lap at Monza - too busy trying to race each other hard, Leclerc eventually crowding an optimistic Hamilton into the gravel exiting the first chicane. Stupid and needless at Ferrari's home race.

Now this. Both were in the wrong to a degree, Leclerc racing his team-mate unnecessarily hard - Hamilton just about went off, but Leclerc wasn't making that corner in a million attempts at that speed.

Wins are rare for Ferrari in F1, it's been a tough season - and Leclerc's had a particularly challenging campaign compared to Hamilton. So I get why he's trying. He absolutely should try. But there's got to be more common sense than that.

Unfortunately it is now a clear pattern. Repeat instances where they (Leclerc especially) have put themselves before the team hurt Ferrari's results, damage the chemistry between the drivers, erode trust and cause needless scrutiny and controversy for a team that's under the magnifying glass more than any other.

It's self-destructive on a micro level because it's hard to see how a Ferrari doesn't win this race without that act of sabotage at Turn 4 but on a macro level there's a more fundamental problem given the bigger picture.
They are at risk of seriously, potentially fatally, undermining Fred Vasseur's leadership. He is the reason Leclerc trusts the project. He brought Hamilton into the team.
If they won't behave for him, will they ever be able to behave for Ferrari?
You would have thought that Ferrari would have learned its lessons from Monza – where Leclerc and Hamilton effectively blew their race at the first chicane.
This time they got as far as Turn 4, with the pair outbraking themselves and leaving the open door for Max Verstappen to come through and take a brilliant win.
Keeping things fair and giving both your drivers an equal chance to fight for wins is the right thing to do, but that stance cannot come if it also means risking throwing away wins.
It is inexcusable for this to have happened now when Monza two months ago exposed an underlying tension already that needed nipping in the bud.

Leclerc and Hamilton's desperation to not concede at Turn 4 appears to have foundations in a lack of trust in each other, and perhaps an unwillingness of team management to intervene, and is something that needs to be addressed because at some point it won’t just be wins Ferrari is throwing away - it is the sort of thing that costs you titles.
This Ferrari loss was ultimately Hamilton's fault, for me. Although we'll never know if he could have held off a charging Verstappen if he’d stayed in front at the start.

If Hamilton hadn't run wide in his duel with Leclerc on lap one, he would have been in the lead and in control of the race. OK, maybe Leclerc should have been told not to fight so hard, but in the absence of any Ferrari racing rules, Hamilton has to race Leclerc like anyone else.
Even if there were rules in place, you have to be ready for the team-mate to break them. F1 history tells us that!
If Hamilton hadn't made that mistake, he'd have been ahead after that exchange.
I have so much respect for Hamilton, but he spent far too much of the race posturing on the radio, and in actual fact he should have taken responsibility for his role in the incident.
Ferrari can't race like it has nothing to lose
With its title hopes long since over, you could argue Ferrari has nothing to lose now so its drivers should just go for broke individually at the remaining races.

But given how long it’s been since this team won any titles, given the overwhelming pressure around Ferrari anytime it does anything disappointing (which is most of the time since the mid-2000s), it needs unity, discipline and smooth, harmonious, race execution now.

It had everything in its hands to finish 1-2 in this race. It needed a plan to ensure it ended the first lap poised to achieve that, and it needed to know it could trust its drivers to follow that plan. It had none of that.
When you don’t have a clearly defined number one driver and your two drivers are fairly equal pace-wise you are always vulnerable to these situations.

We've seen it between Senna and Prost, Mansell and Piquet, Hamilton and Rosberg, Norris and Piastri, even Verstappen and Ricciardo before Red Bull realised without this clear definition you lose more than you gain.

We have seen it on many occasions that Ferrari are fairly slow and to add to that weak at pitlane strategy decision making. The problem in this race was that both Leclerc and Hamilton went off track exiting Turn 4, however Hamilton did make the apex of Turn 5 on the track, whereas Leclerc didn’t bother and clearly opened up an advantage, so a five-second penalty for that is justified.
However what it doesn’t make up for is the time loss that Hamilton suffered by having to run that first part of the race in dirty air whilst Leclerc could run out front in clean air.

I don’t know what you do about that other than the penalty being applied immediately while on track, so basically in this instance if the driver himself or team doesn’t request its driver to give up the gained position or gained time by the point the FIA have made its decision, then you have to give up that applied penalty time loss by the next time you cross the start-finish line.
If that means you lose more positions, then so be it.
What is a little more worrying is that Leclerc didn’t seem to learn anything from that initial episode and was just as or even more aggressive at the restart after the red flag.
Maranello - or wherever they will have their Monday post-race debrief - will be a bit exciting.

Both Leclerc and Hamilton went off at Turn 4, with Hamilton losing out to Verstappen as a result.

relatedItems.titleZh: 汉密尔顿因法拉利本周五表现最差面临巴西大奖赛发车罚退
relatedItems.summaryZh: 汉密尔顿将在本周末的巴西大奖赛中面临发车罚退，原因是法拉利在本周五的表现是2026年最差的。他在FP2中是车队最快的车手，但比基米·安东内利的基准成绩慢了0.450秒，队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔落后近三十分之一。法拉利的长时间跑速也排在第四位。

media.altZh: 汉密尔顿因法拉利本周五表现最差面临巴西大奖赛发车罚退 · 第 1 张

relatedItems.originalTitle: Hamilton set for Brazil grid penalty after Ferrari's worst 2026 Friday
detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿将在本周末的巴西大奖赛中被处以发车位罚分，这是法拉利2026年迄今为止最糟糕的一个周五。
汉密尔顿在FP2练习中是速度较快的法拉利车手，但比基米·安东内利的基准成绩慢了0.450秒，队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔落后近三十分之一，这种差距主要是由起终点直道上的部署问题造成的。
法拉利的长距离速度看起来也稳固地排在第四位，勒克莱尔在相同轮胎上的长距离每圈比安东内利慢半秒。
法拉利在预期的弱点上表现不佳——从Juncao到计时线的全油门长距离行驶——汉密尔顿（红色线条）在这一部分仅对安东内利（蓝色线条）落后三十分之一。
汉密尔顿在到达4号弯左转前的第二个直道上比安东内利慢了11公里每小时，在那里失去了超过十分之半的时间。
但法拉利在弯道上的通常优势在巴西也并不完全存在，正如勒克莱尔在FP2之后确认的那样，他说‘在弯道上的车感觉可能是本赛季最糟糕的周五感觉之一’。
车队老板弗雷德·瓦瑟尔承认，‘在平衡方面还有很多工作要做’。
《赛车》杂志了解到，汉密尔顿将面临一场发车线处罚，因为法拉利计划在FP2之后更换发动机部件。
汉密尔顿从五位发车位起跑，凭借在冲刺赛中从第20位冲到第5位，最终在2021年巴西大奖赛中从第10位发车位逆袭夺冠，这成为了他著名的逆转故事。
乔治·拉塞尔已经确认将面临五位发车位罚退。
队友勒克莱尔可能在下一轮拉斯维加斯的比赛中因为引擎部件更换而受到发车位罚退。
法拉利需要在巴西避免被梅赛德斯以三分之差超越，以避免在本周末的 构造商锦标赛中被锁定。
那是在周五之后看起来有些棘手的事情，因为世界冠军基米·安东内利的梅赛德斯在短距离和长距离的比赛中都是最快的。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton is set to take a grid penalty for this weekend’s Formula 1 Brazilian Grand Prix after Ferrari’s weakest Friday of 2026 so far.

Hamilton was the faster Ferrari in FP2, but he was 0.450s slower than Kimi Antonelli’s benchmark, with team-mate Charles Leclerc almost another three tenths adrift - a deficit mostly explained by a deployment issue on the start/finish straight.
Ferrari’s long run pace looked firmly fourth-best, too, with Leclerc’s long-run over half a second per lap slower than Antonelli on the same tyre.
The Ferrari is weak where you’d expect - the long full-throttle run from Juncao to the timing line - as Hamilton (red line) ships three tenths to Antonelli (blue line) in that section alone.
Hamilton was also 11km/h slower than Antonelli on the second straight before they reach the Turn 4 left-hander, Descida de Lago, losing over a tenth and a half there.

But Ferrari’s usual prowess in corners isn’t fully present in Brazil either, as Leclerc confirmed after FP2, saying the “car in the corners just felt probably one of the worst Friday feelings of the season”.
Team boss Fred Vasseur admitted there was “a lot of work to do on the balance” overnight.
The Race understands Hamilton is set for a grid penalty as Ferrari has planned engine component changes post-FP2.
Hamilton famously bounced back from a five-place grid penalty to win the 2021 Brazilian Grand Prix from 10th on the grid, having charged from 20th to fifth in the sprint race.
George Russell already has a five-place grid penalty confirmed.
Team-mate Leclerc may get a grid penalty at the next round in Las Vegas for the engine component changes.
Ferrari needs to avoid being outscored by Mercedes by three points in Brazil to avoid the constructors' championship being sealed this weekend.
That's something that looks tricky after Friday as world champion Kimi Antonelli's Mercedes was quickest on the short and long runs.
keyPointsZh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔落后近三十分之一，主要原因是起跑/终点直道上的部署问题。
keyPointsEn: Charles Leclerc was almost another three tenths adrift.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安德森对迈凯轮2027年概念前翼的看法
relatedItems.summaryZh: 安德森认为迈凯轮将新前翼称为2027年概念有些奇怪，但他认为如果它在赛道和模拟工具中表现出潜力，应该现在就开始使用。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Gary Anderson's verdict on McLaren's 2027-leaning upgrade
detailZh: 没有车队愿意在公共场合展示自己的脏衣服，所以麦凯轮将其新前翼称为2027年概念似乎很奇怪。
在那个位置，如果赛道上的数据和模拟工具显示它有潜力，我会现在就使用它，并且会非常重视它作为2026年的部件。在剩下大约四场比赛和下一个赛季开始前五个月的时间里，我会尽可能多地从中学习，并希望在下个赛季开始之前，通过它取得一步或两步的进步。
主平面和尾翼下部的交汇处，用红色椭圆突出显示，是吸引我注意的地方。
红牛赛季初就采用了这个概念，梅赛德斯和其他车队也紧随其后。将其更多地设计为单一的下表面，可以减少尾翼底部对地面的敏感性，因此在高速弯角处，汽车的前部应该产生更一致的下压力。基本上，它应该感觉不那么抓地，使汽车的后部更加稳定。
前部和中央元素之间的槽口轮廓，用绿色箭头突出显示，也已经发生了改变。
这与用浅蓝色箭头突出显示的轮廓变化以及第三元素最长弦段的定位一致。由于该部分略微向内移动，这将改变气流到达地板前缘的位置。
让我有点困惑的是，从直线模式中减少第二和第三元素的角度，到仅减少第三元素的角度，当直线模式激活时。这意味着前翼在弯道模式中力量较小，但这是以整体下压力为代价的。
当机翼处于弯道模式（最大下压力）时，下表面的低压将更多地将其气流通过第一和第二元素之间的槽口。为了补偿这一点，迈凯轮减少了主翼弦长，用绿色箭头突出显示，并增加了第二元素的弦长，用浅蓝色箭头突出显示。
将机翼安装在第二个元素上，如红色椭圆所示，这个概念是合理的，因为它具有最佳的刚度和重量比，但前提是你不将中翼作为直线模式翼角减少的一部分。因此，这可能加上汽车似乎在低速到中速弯角和高速弯角之间平衡方面存在问题的实际情况，导致了麦凯轮队采用这个概念。
后翼尾缘也有一些小的改进，如绿色箭头所示。我看不到足够的信息来判断它是否是一个全新的套件，但我已经指出了这些小的改进。这些改进将改善机翼下方的气流，这些气流受到双支撑柱的影响。在这些安装背后的微小气流分离问题可以非常容易地扩散到机翼下方的更大区域。麦凯轮队还宣布了一种新的扩散器和重新设计的后梁翼。
今年梁翼的弦长比以往赛季短得多，但在提高扩散器性能方面仍然非常强大。我没有足够的信息来详细说明扩散器。
这基本上是影响汽车整体性能的主要组件，因此车队通常会很好地隐藏这些组件。
“尽管我有一半的时间是半场，但我们明天会把所有的升级都放在一起，升级似乎给了我们希望的结果，我会这么说。”这是兰多·诺里斯在周五对升级的早期评价。
“最终，升级是为了提高圈速和性能。它们不是为了仅仅改善操控。完美的升级是那种既能提高圈速，同时又能提升操控性的升级，尤其是在这辆车如此难以操控的情况下。”
“我认为可能有一些小的改变朝着正确的方向；它似乎驾驶起来更加直接。”
“但我认为我们永远不能仅仅在一个赛道上就对事情做出判断。但到目前为止，对于今天来说，事情似乎更加直接，这是好事。”
让我们看看周六和周日当这一切真正重要时，它的表现如何，以及麦凯轮是否能在周末的比赛中保持所有这些组件在车上。
detailEn: No team wants to show its dirty washing in public, so McLaren calling its new front wing effectively a 2027 concept seems strange.

In that position, assuming the numbers on track and the simulation tools show it has potential, I’d be using it now and considering it very much a 2026 part. With (perhaps) four races remaining and roughly five months before the start of next season, I’d be learning as much as possible from it and would hopefully make a step or two as a result of it before next season kicks off.
The intersection between the mainplane and the lower foot of the endplate, highlighted with the red ellipse, is what caught my eye.

Red Bull started the season with this concept, and Mercedes and others have followed. Making it more of a single lower surface reduces the sensitivity of the endplate footplate to the track, so in high-speed corners the front of the car should produce more consistent downforce. Basically, it should feel less snatchy, making the rear of the car more stable.
The slot gap profile between the forward and central elements, highlighted with the green arrow, has also been altered.

This is in line with the profile change highlighted with the light blue arrow and the positioning of the longest chord section of the third element. With that section slightly more inboard, this will alter where the mass flow reaches the leading edge of the floor.

What confuses me a little is the change from reducing the angle of the second and third elements in straight mode to reducing only the angle of the third when straight mode is activated. It means that the front wing is less powerful in corner mode, but that comes at the expense of overall downforce.

When the wing is in cornering mode (max downforce), the low pressure on the lower surface will pull more of its airflow through the slot gap between the first and second elements. To compensate for this, McLaren has reduced the chord length of the mainplane, highlighted with the green arrow, and increased the chord length of the second element, highlighted with the light blue arrow.

Mounting the wing on the second element, as highlighted with the red ellipse is sensible with this concept as it’s the best stiffness-to-weight compromise, but only if you don’t use the mid-flap as part of the straight-line mode wing angle reduction. So perhaps that, together with the fact that the car seems to be struggling with the balance between low- to medium-speed corners and high-speed corners, has led McLaren to this concept.

There are also small additions to the rear wing trailing edge, highlighted with the green arrows. I can’t really see enough to tell if it’s a completely new package, but I’ve highlighted the small additions. These will improve the airflow on the wing’s underside, which is affected by the twin mounting pillars. A small airflow separation problem behind those mountings can very easily spread across a much wider section of the wing’s underside.McLaren has also declared a new diffuser and a re-profiled rear beam wing.

This year the beam wing has a much shorter chord than in previous seasons, but it’s still very powerful when it comes to improving the performance of the diffuser. I don’t have the visual information to go into much detail on the diffuser.
It’s basically the component that has a major influence on the overall performance of the car, so teams tend to keep these components well hidden.

"The upgrades, even though I had half and then half, and we’re going to put everything together for tomorrow, the upgrades seem to have given what we hoped for, I would say," was Lando Norris's early verdict on Friday.

"Ultimately, the upgrades are there to bring laptime and bring performance. They’re not set out just to improve handling. A perfect upgrade is one that brings laptime and at the same time brings a handling upgrade, especially with how tricky the car’s been.
"I would say maybe there’s a small change in the right direction; it seems just a little bit more straightforward to drive.
"But I don’t think we can ever judge things over just one track. But so far, for today, things have seemed a little bit more straightforward, which is a good thing."
Let’s see how it all performs when it matters on Saturday and Sunday and if McLaren keeps all these components on the car as the weekend progresses.
keyPointsZh: 新前翼的设计旨在提高高速弯角时的下压力一致性。
keyPointsEn: The design of the new front wing aims to improve downforce consistency in high-speed corners.

relatedItems.titleZh: 赫塔成功通过最后F1超级执照障碍
relatedItems.summaryZh: 科尔顿·赫塔在巴西大奖赛周五练习赛中，凭借无罚分的出色表现，成功通过了获得F1超级执照的最后障碍。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Herta finally clears his last F1 superlicence hurdle
detailZh: 科尔顿·赫塔凭借无罚分的出色表现，成功通过了获得F1超级执照的最后障碍。
赫塔取代了佩雷斯参加在伊纳莫斯举行的FP1练习赛，他和凯迪拉克车队都在寻求获得赫塔获得超级执照所需的最后一点积分。
赫塔有望在下赛季为车队参赛，即使2027年来得过早，现在获得超级执照也将使他在未来几年保持作为备选车手的可能性更大。
一名车手在首次申请超级执照时需要积累40个超级执照积分。凯迪拉克车队认为在墨西哥FP1练习赛一周前，这一目标已经实现，但赫塔在之前的一次IndyCar赛事结果出现混淆后，仍然缺少一个积分。
他立即回到车内，为巴西队锁定了胜利，只要他完成了100公里并且在这个环节中没有获得任何罚分。
赫塔在FP1早期出现的红旗可能会显著缩短赛程，以至于他完成的圈数不足以计入成绩——而且当赫塔在红旗亮起后经过维修区入口时，也引起了一阵短暂的恐慌。
没有采取任何行动，因为很明显红灯面板亮得太晚，他无法做出反应并进入维修区。
凯迪拉克的马克·海因斯在周五晚上表示，车队想要非常清楚100公里的限制是来自总里程还是仅来自计时圈数，但无论如何，赫塔都是安全的。
赛车理解国际汽联对他FP1的表现感到满意，因此超级驾照积分将被获得，他的资格将在适当的时候得到确认。
赫塔在FP1中完成了完整的计划，但在切换到软胎之前，由于一些锁死现象，硬胎的早期圈速受到了影响，这导致他的最佳圈速比瓦尔特里·博塔斯慢了0.904秒，比目标凯迪拉克设定的圈速慢了0.275秒。
赫塔原计划在当天结束时与媒体交谈，但后来因为凯迪拉克说他感觉不舒服，所以退出了这些活动。
然而，当海恩斯发言时，他说赫塔在F1的工作中取得了良好的进展，与此同时，他在令人失望的F2赛季中排名仅第19位。
“来到欧洲追逐F1梦想是一大步，我非常钦佩这一点，”海恩斯说。
“F2很困难。你面对的是那些从卡丁车起家、在同一级别中脱颖而出的车手，他们熟悉所有赛道——在F2的练习赛中你几乎得不到什么里程，他们对轮胎非常了解，驾驶风格也固定了。所以进入那个环境是很艰难的。”
“FP1是一个很好的机会来积累一些里程，而且他每次都变得更好。你不会像第一次那样紧张，现在他在那里看起来非常自信。”
detailEn: Colton Herta has cleared the final hurdles to qualifying for a Formula 1 superlicence with his penalty-free and productive Friday practice outing for Cadillac at the Brazilian Grand Prix.
Herta replaced Sergio Perez in FP1 at Interlagos, where he and Cadillac were seeking to seal the final point needed for Herta to be eligible for a superlicence.

He is a contender to race for the team next season but even if 2027 comes too soon getting a superlicence now would also make it much easier for Herta to remain an option in the years that follow, too.

A driver needs to accrue 40 superlicence points when applying for the first time. Cadillac thought this had already been achieved after his Mexico FP1 appearance a week ago, but Herta was still one short after a mix-up over a previous IndyCar result.
He was immediately back in the car for Brazil to seal the deal, though, so long as he completed 100km and did not get any penalty points on his licence in the session.

Herta could have been tripped up on either count. The red flag that emerged early in FP1 could have shortened running significantly enough that he did not do enough laps for it to count – and it also caused a brief scare when Herta went past the pit entry after the session had been red-flagged.
No action was taken as it was clear the red light panels came on too late for him to react and get into the pitlane.

Cadillac’s Marc Hynes said on Friday evening that the team wanted to be absolutely clear whether the 100km limit comes from total mileage or only mileage from timed laps, but either way Herta would be safe.
The Race understands the FIA is satisfied with what he did in FP1 so the superlicence point will be earned and his eligibility will be confirmed in due course.

Herta ran a full programme in FP1 with early laps on hard tyres hampered by some lock-ups before a switch to softs, which yielded a best lap 0.904s slower than Valtteri Bottas over one lap and 0.275s slower than the target Cadillac set him.
Herta was due to speak to media at the end of the day but withdrew from those activities as Cadillac said he was feeling unwell.
When Hynes spoke, though, he said Herta was making good progress with his F1 work dovetailed alongside a disappointing Formula 2 campaign in which he is only 19th in the standings.
"It was a huge step to come to Europe chasing the F1 dream, and I hugely admire that," Hynes said.

"F2 is difficult. You’ve got the guys that have come through in the same peer set from karting, they know all the tracks – you get very little mileage in F2 practice, they know the tyre very well, and the driving style is baked in. So to come into that is tough.
"FP1 is a good opportunity to get some mileage, and he’s got better every time. The nerves aren’t there that you have for the first one, and he’s really looking assured out there now."

赫塔取代了佩雷斯参加在伊纳莫斯举行的FP1练习赛。
赫塔有望在下赛季为车队参赛，即使2027年来得过早，现在获得超级执照也将使他在未来几年保持作为备选车手的可能性更大。
keyPointsEn: Colton Herta successfully cleared the final hurdle to obtaining a Formula 1 superlicence with his impressive performance in the Friday practice session for Cadillac at the Brazilian Grand Prix.
Herta replaced Sergio Perez in FP1 at Interlagos, where he and Cadillac were aiming to secure the final point needed for Herta to be eligible for a superlicence.

He is a contender to race for the team next season, but even if 2027 comes too soon, obtaining a superlicence now would also make it much easier for Herta to remain an option in the years that follow.
